protocol: held-out random MuJoCo targets; same full palette, 32 candidates, equal iteration budget

proposed_config.notes: General refinement from the 1107014 symmetric objective: stable 2ms brush contact, 2000 random self-play transitions, unchanged UNet/training schedule, RGB-supported thin-region PCA/RANSAC, learned seed ranking, Appendix-B footprint/disk colour sampling. Shared palette and parameters for all targets; no target action, task-specific colour subset, or reference prefix fed as the observed state. Train-only BatchNorm population calibration; no gradient/artwork input. Generic learned blank-reference coverage for equal-luminance colour transitions, and enumerate seed order (H<=5).

previous_config.notes: Actual-observation PCA/RANSAC; opaque task premixes; no target trajectories. RGB auxiliary objective is a local extension. Palette slots 22/23 are deployment premixes, classified via new simulation patch calibration. Transparent branch not reproduced.

stage1.notes: Paper robot family, 18x21 inch canvas, 24 wells, short 50 mm brush and Fig. A1 mount structure. Unpublished assembly dimensions estimated locally. Axial spring brush and continuous height-feedback force servo are simulation approximations.

stage2.action_normalization: x0/y0/length use patch-width scaling; signed bend maps symmetrically to [0,1] around 0.5; force and angle use min-max mappings
stage2.notes: 900/100 fresh MuJoCo transitions, opaque task-specific premixes; same UNet and optimizer. Color palette derives from image color statistics only. Fresh brush per stroke. No artwork trajectories in training.

stage1.notes: Paper robot family, 18x21 inch canvas, 24 wells, short 50 mm brush and Fig. A1 mount structure. Unpublished assembly dimensions estimated locally. Axial spring brush and continuous height-feedback force servo are simulation approximations. General stability refinement: brush penalty-contact relaxation 20 ms instead of 6 ms. Original timestep, controller period, axial spring, servo and paint deposition retained. This is a local numerical contact choice, not a paper hardware parameter.

stage2.action_normalization: x0/y0/length use patch-width scaling; signed bend maps symmetrically to [0,1] around 0.5; force and angle use min-max mappings
stage2.notes: General refinement beyond the 900/100 paper data budget: 1800/200 real MuJoCo transitions. Half force proposals uniform in 0.4-0.65 N, half uniform over the full action range. Unchanged UNet, optimizer, loss and 1000 epochs. All 24 pigments, random geometry, no target images or target trajectories.
